next_step: POC kickoff: infra diagram + sample dataset ingest (week of 2025-02-10)
notes: 2024-11-12: inbound via content-partner referral. initial discovery call w/ CTO (Marta Ruiz) + head of search ops.
Primary problem: 30+ years of media transcripts + editorial, large binary assets + time-aligned transcripts. users need semantic search across long records (hours-long transcripts).
Scale: estimate 40M source files -> after chunking ~300M passages (varies by chunk size). current infra: object store (S3-compatible), Postgres metadata.
Use-case priority: 1) accurate retrieval for newsroom search, 2) fast developer-facing search endpoint for customers, 3) summarization for long-form clips.
Latency/throughput targets: p95 end-to-end <= 400ms for short queries, target steady-state throughput 40-80 QPS for peak newsroom hours.
Cost goals: target cost-per-query <= $0.03 (avg) for a retrieval + rerank pipeline. very cost-sensitive on cross-encoder use in production.
Chunking: team debating semantic vs fixed-token chunking. preferences: variable chunking by scene/paragraph boundaries (2k-4k token windows), sliding overlap 10-20% for continuity.
Embedding strategy: dense embeddings with 1536-d model candidate (opt for lower-dim for cost). store precomputed embeddings in object store and vector DB (hot tier) + warm/cold split.

Reranker approach: want lightweight bi-encoder for initial sort + cross-encoder for top-K. experiments proposed: prefilter k=1000 -> bi-encoder top 200 -> cross-encoder top 50. note: cross-encoder latency spike is blocker.
Evaluation metrics requested: recall@10, MRR, nDCG across editorial testset (5k queries). Redwood requested to run evaluation harness (we will share test prompts).
Security/regulatory: some archive items require EU-only residency + retention locks for rights management. SSO + audit logs required. legal asks to confirm KMS + on-prem option for selected buckets.

POC plan (3 weeks): week1 ingest 500k transcripts (representative mix); week2 run retrieval + reranker experiments; week3 SLA/load test and cost-modeling. deliverable: perf/cost report + recommendation matrix.
Notes from 2025-01-28 call: 'We need reranker precision to avoid false positives — newsroom editors can't afford noise.' CTO wants a demo with live editing workflow integration.

Open technical questions: best overlap for semantic continuity vs index size, acceptable top-K for cross-encoder in production, vector index sharding strategy for 300M vectors, warm/cold tiering for cost control.

Redwood-specific asks: example configs for continuous batching, suggested quantized model profiles, recommended routing policy when dedicated capacity is saturated, sample RBAC for private deployment.

Next tactical steps: send ingestion sample spec (data mapping + redaction checklist), Redwood SE to provide POC infra worksheet and cost-sim tool. scheduling: POC kickoff 2025-02-10 (pending legal NDA).
